nodes.name: Sklearn Ensemble Stacking Meta-Feature Atoms
nodes.description: Deterministic stacking helpers for normalizing base-estimator prediction outputs into meta-features and naming the resulting transform columns.

nodes.name: stacking_meta_feature_matrix
nodes.description: Concatenate sklearn-style normalized stacking prediction outputs, optionally with passthrough features, into one meta-feature matrix.
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: tuple[PredictionEntry, ...], stack_method_names: tuple[str, ...], is_binary_classification: bool, X: NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix | None = None, passthrough: bool = False) -> NDArray[np.float64] | scipy.sparse.spmatrix

nodes.name: stacking_meta_feature_widths
nodes.description: Return the sklearn-style per-block output widths after stacking prediction normalization.
nodes.type_signature: (predictions: tuple[PredictionEntry, ...], stack_method_names: tuple[str, ...], is_binary_classification: bool) -> NDArray[np.int64]

nodes.name: stacking_feature_names_out
nodes.description: Build sklearn-style stacking transform feature names from estimator names, output widths, and optional passthrough feature names.
nodes.type_signature: (class_name: str, estimator_names: tuple[str, ...], feature_widths: NDArray[np.int64], input_features: Sequence[str] | NDArray[np.object_] | None = None, passthrough: bool = False) -> NDArray[np.object_]
